body: Checked seven more candidates before calling it. All confirmed sound: the two remaining hardcoded-20-bar exit loops (both run before regime-specific horizons exist, correct by design), the deflated-Sharpe history tracker (genuinely wired, persists across restarts, not orphaned), live weight-overwrite paths (none found outside expected sites), and Kelly sizing's core formula (correctly parameterized and bounded). One real candidate flagged but NOT chased down: where Kelly's live win-rate input ultimately comes from -- that's a full separate pipeline trace, not a quick boundary check, so I'm leaving it as a real, named, unscoped item rather than rushing it or silently dropping it. Ten total candidates checked across tonight's two audit rounds; only WARRANT#101/102 were real. This is a genuine plateau, not me stopping early -- continuing to hunt without a specific lead at this point would mean manufacturing changes just to keep shipping warrants, which is exactly the thing this whole campaign has avoided doing all night. Ledger at pass_83, source unchanged since WARRANT#102. The single highest-value thing left is an actual live run of everything shipped tonight (WARRANT#91-102) so the new diagnostic lines (P1 keys3-edge-by-R, forge-organism portal-audit) can report real numbers instead of me speculating further from static analysis.
